scope: CVG-002B2B bounded repository-local database-enforced service-principal writer linearization

criteria.description: The additive migration installs database-enforced triggers for every account_service_principals INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and users account_id, principal_kind, interactive_login_enabled and is_active UPDATE, with SECURITY DEFINER search_path hardened to pg_catalog, pg_temp, qualified advisory helpers and revoked public execution.
criteria.limitations: The trigger boundary is verified in repository-local disposable PostgreSQL; target role ownership and production catalog governance remain outside this gate.

criteria.description: Direct writers take an account-prefixed transaction writer gate with try-before-wait semantics and then the worker account lock; cross-account changes use deterministic order, conflicts fail with retryable 40001 and independent accounts remain concurrent without a global mutex.
criteria.limitations: This proves the defined PostgreSQL advisory-lock protocol and does not certify performance, failover or distributed target-cluster behavior.

criteria.description: The real settlement consumer remains unchanged in semantics: a trigger-backed direct writer can commit revocation while the worker waits, after which the worker re-reads the principal, fails closed and invokes B1 zero times.
criteria.limitations: The provider is synthetic/local and this gate does not authorize external payment providers, credentials or production settlement.

criteria.description: Migration replay/catalog, focused static contracts, worker regressions, migration-source validation, RLS validation, secret scan, lint and targeted diff hygiene pass on the final snapshot.
criteria.limitations: The evidence is focused/local; it does not claim whole-workspace coverage, remote CI or release readiness.

criteria.description: Two fresh separated read-only reviewers inspected the final security-hardened snapshot and returned APPROVE_BOUNDED with no P0, P1 or P2 finding.
criteria.limitations: Approval is limited to this repository-local writer/PIX identity boundary.

criteria.description: The bounded writer result is reconciled without promoting CVG-002B2B, global ERP, Vetus parity, clinical parity, target operations, production or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: Global audits remain non-promoting: Vetus 4/11 verified, clinical 2/3 verified and enterprise readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS, 3 WARN and 1 FAIL.
